name: Ascetic Vows (Akashic)
body:
You gain the ability to take and channel power from ascetic vows.

Increasing the potency of your essence in exchange for giving up worldly comforts.

Prerequisite(s): Essence Pool, mental ability score 13

Benefit(s): You can take ascetic vows. Additionally, you add Ajna of the Ascetic to your veil list. You still must be able to shape veils to shape Ajna of the Ascetic.

Special: You can gain this feat in exchange for any bonus feat granted by an akashic class, or by an akashic class archetype or template. If you retrain or otherwise replace this feat you can’t take it again.
